text_block_list.text:
One day. We were training in racewear
to simulate the real race, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
G-Goooaal!
That was a pretty good run!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's thanks to your racing outfit?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Whenever I wear these clothes, I feel like I can run faster than usual.
Th-Though that might just be my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly grateful...
To think you went out of your way to design it
just for someone like me.
choice_data_list: What kind of request did you make?
What kind of request did you make?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way, I couldn't possibly make a request!
I'm not fashionable, and 'functionality'?
I don't really understand that stuff either.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, whether it looks wonderful or is easy to run in,
it's all thanks to the designer.
I pretty much left everything to them, after all...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Auugh...
I'm so sorry... Actually, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I only made one wish.
Even though someone like me probably shouldn't have...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...She asked if I could attach the bag for her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... This is a story from when I was a kid, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've been clumsy ever since I was little,
always tripping or wandering off and getting lost.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And then Mom handed me
what she called a "peace-of-mind pouch"...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Inside were just really ordinary things, like bandages, a towel, and contact info, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you have this, you'll be fine no matter what happens."
That's what Mom told me, so—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I felt anxious or nervous,
I'd grip my safety bag tight and do my best.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, when I had my racing outfit made,
I immediately remembered that bag."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If I end up running in even bigger races from now on, I'm sure I'll be terrified and nervous, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With this reassurance bag,
I feel like I can do my best.
choice_data_list: If it's a precious bag, shall we take it in for maintenance?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With this reassurance bag,
I feel like I can do my best.
choice_data_list: If it's a precious bag, shall we take it in for maintenance?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, grooming...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-you're right, I did run on the track, so it got a little dirty...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Wow.
My bag is so shiny and clean now!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You can get bags polished at a store?
I had no idea you could do that.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, b-but the shop clerk taught me how to take care of it, so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll polish my bag myself after races.
After all, it's my soothing comfort bag.

Saying that, Meisho Doto treasured the shiny bag,
hugging it tightly to her chest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... Actually, I haven't prepared it yet...

With that decided, I took the hesitant
Meisho Doto along with me to the school store.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what we'll need... Band-aids, disinfectant,
and a towel for when someone falls—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A sewing kit, and extra towels too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A natural gemstone keychain...?
It's all sparkly and cute, but...
choice_data_list: Wouldn't that work nicely as a good luck charm?
Wouldn't that work nicely as a good luck charm?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But, I mean, I want it, but
I don't have that kind of allowance...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-B-B-But...
That's way too gracious for someone like me...
choice_data_list: Because I want you to keep running safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I really am so sorry...
Doing something like that for someone like me—
Tr-Trainaaar!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... I'm so happy... Thank
you, Trainer. I will treasure it
forever...

True to her word, Meisho Doto carefully
tucked the keychain into her bag.
